desk.label: Product cards on a computer: back view and Quick add
desk.help: Only on a computer with a mouse (never on a phone or a touch screen). Back view: with the mouse on a card, its back photo (or the drawing's back) shows. Quick add: the sizes in stock in the card's colour show over the picture; one click puts that size in the bag, as the product page's Add to bag does. A size out of stock is not shown.

structuredData.label: Data for search engines (structured data)
structuredData.help: What Google reads beside the page, always from what the page itself shows: the breadcrumb trail (sent even when the visible trail is off), the list of products on a category page, and on a product page the product, its price and whether it is in stock. A star rating is never sent until real reviews exist.
